GRADE 8 ENGLISH — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify adverbs of frequency and degree correctly from a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

2. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use adverbs of frequency and degree correctly in sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

3. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify adverbs of frequency and degree correctly from a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.

5. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main ideas in the short story,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story.

6. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise the key events in the short story,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story.

7. About Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. relate the main ideas in the short story to real life situations,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story completely.
   C. Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story.

9. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. spell commonly misspelt words correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing.

10. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use prefixes and suffixes correctly in writing,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing.

11. About Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. write words with silent vowels (-ie and -ei) correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing.

13. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify polite words and phrases in telephone conversations,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail.

14. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. conduct a telephone conversation using polite words and expressions,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail.

15. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify polite words and phrases in telephone conversations,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail.

17. About Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals.

18. About Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. make a connection between visuals and the written text,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals.

19. About Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret visuals correctly for meaning,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals.

21. About Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns.

22. About Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns.

23. About Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify indefinite and reflexive pronouns correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns.

25. About Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the characters in a given short story,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story completely.
   C. Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.

26. About Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the relationship between the characters in the short story,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story completely.
   C. Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.

27. About Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the characters in a given short story,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story completely.
   C. Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.

29. About Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the steps in the writing process,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing completely.
   C. Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing.

30. About Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write a dialogue on a given topic,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing completely.
   C. Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing.

31. About Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the steps in the writing process,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing completely.
   C. Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in a conversation with a classmate.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Reading: short story in a conversation with a classmate.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 6.5.1 Mechanics of Writing in a conversation with a classmate.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Listening and Speaking 7.1.1: Listening for Detail in a conversation with a classmate.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in a conversation with a classmate.
